refs.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
refs.gloss: Hearts find rest only through the remembrance of Allah.

refs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
refs.gloss: With every hardship comes ease.
The Prophet's dua for anxiety: 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from helplessness and laziness.'

refs.arabic: إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
refs.gloss: The Prophet ﷺ reassured Abu Bakr in the cave: 'Do not grieve, Allah is with us.'
Know that whatever has passed you by was not going to befall you, and whatever has befallen you was not going to pass you by.

refs.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
refs.gloss: To Allah we belong and to Him we return — said at a calamity, met with Allah's blessings and mercy.
True patience is at the first stroke of grief.

refs.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ
refs.gloss: Allah is with you wherever you are.
Whenever people gather to remember Allah, angels surround them, mercy covers them, and tranquility descends upon them.

refs.arabic: وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
refs.gloss: Those who restrain their anger and pardon people — Allah loves the doers of good.
The strong one is not the wrestler, but the one who controls himself when angry.

refs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
refs.gloss: Seeking refuge from the evil of an envier when he envies.
Beware of envy, for it devours good deeds as fire devours wood.

refs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا أَوْ يَظْلِمْ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ يَجِدِ اللَّهَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
refs.gloss: Whoever does wrong or wrongs himself, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, will find Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
Every son of Adam sins, and the best of sinners are those who repent.

refs.arabic: لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
refs.gloss: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah — He forgives all sins.
Allah is more delighted with the repentance of His servant than a traveler who, having lost his ride laden with provisions in a barren desert, suddenly finds it again.

refs.arabic: فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا
refs.gloss: Let believers rejoice in Allah's grace — better than anything they accumulate.
Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.

refs.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً ذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا
refs.gloss: Those who, having done wrong, remember Allah and seek forgiveness.
Modesty (haya') is a branch of faith.

refs.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
refs.gloss: Dua: our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us.
When Satan's whispers reach the point of 'who created your Lord?', seek refuge in Allah and put the thought aside.

refs.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
refs.gloss: When My servants ask about Me, indeed I am near.
Whoever draws near to Me a hand's span, I draw near to him an arm's length.

refs.arabic: الشَّيْطَانُ يَعِدُكُمُ الْفَقْرَ وَيَأْمُرُكُم بِالْفَحْشَاءِ
refs.gloss: Satan threatens poverty and commands immorality; Allah promises forgiveness and abundance.
The Fire is surrounded by desires, and Paradise is surrounded by hardships.

refs.arabic: إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَاتِ
refs.gloss: Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds.
Even if your sins reached the clouds of the sky, and then you sought My forgiveness, I would forgive you.

refs.arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
refs.gloss: Indeed, I am Allah — there is no god but Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
The Prophet's dua sought refuge from laziness alongside grief and cowardice.

refs.arabic: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ
refs.gloss: They were commanded only to worship Allah, sincere to Him in religion.
Actions are judged by intentions.

refs.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
refs.gloss: Every soul will taste death; then to Us you will be returned.
Remember often the destroyer of pleasures — death.

refs.arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
refs.gloss: Perhaps you dislike a thing which is good for you, and perhaps you like a thing which is bad for you — Allah knows, and you do not.
The Istikhara prayer, taught by the Prophet like a surah of the Quran, for guidance in any matter.

refs.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
refs.gloss: Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without limit.
The heart grieves and the eye sheds tears, but only what pleases Allah is said.

refs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
refs.gloss: Ibrahim's words: and when I am ill, it is He who cures me.
No fatigue, illness, worry or harm befalls a Muslim, even a thorn-prick, except that Allah expiates some of his sins for it.

refs.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
refs.gloss: Whoever is mindful of Allah — He will make a way out for him.
Dua: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, away from what You have made unlawful.

refs.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
refs.gloss: Whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him.
If you relied on Allah with the reliance He is due, He would provide for you as He provides for birds: they set out hungry in the morning and return full in the evening.

refs.arabic: وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
refs.gloss: Allah placed love and mercy between spouses.
The best of you are those who are best to their wives, and I am the best of you to my wives.

refs.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
refs.gloss: Dua for parents, adaptable as a dua for one's own children's wellbeing.
Each of you is a shepherd, and each of you is responsible for his flock — a man is a shepherd of his household and is responsible for them.

refs.arabic: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ غَافِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ
refs.gloss: Never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do.
Beware the supplication of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah.

refs.arabic: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
refs.gloss: Repel evil with what is better, and your enemy may become a close friend.
Shall I not tell you of something better than fasting, prayer, and charity? Making peace between people — for corrupted relations are the destroyer of faith.

refs.arabic: فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ
refs.gloss: Then either retain with kindness or release with good treatment.
Divorce, while permitted, is the most disliked of lawful things to Allah.

refs.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
refs.gloss: Zakariyya's dua for a child in old age, answered with Yahya.
Three duas are answered without doubt: the dua of the oppressed, the dua of the traveler, and the dua of a parent for their child.

refs.arabic: وَمَن يُهَاجِرْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَجِدْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُرَاغَمًا كَثِيرًا
refs.gloss: Whoever migrates for Allah's sake will find abundant refuge and provision.
The Muhajir (migrant) is one who gives up what Allah has forbidden.

refs.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
refs.gloss: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.
If Allah wants good for someone, He afflicts him with trials.

refs.arabic: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
refs.gloss: Call upon Me and I will respond to you.
A servant's dua is answered as long as he doesn't grow impatient and say 'I supplicated and it was not answered.'

refs.arabic: أَحَسِبَ النَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوا أَن يَقُولُوا آمَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ
refs.gloss: Do people think they will be left without being tested, as those before them were?
How wonderful is the affair of the believer — if good befalls him he is grateful, and if hardship befalls him he is patient, and both are good for him.

refs.arabic: ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ
refs.gloss: Repel a bad deed with what is better.
The believer who mixes with people and patiently bears their harm has greater reward than one who avoids people altogether.

refs.arabic: قُلْ بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا
refs.gloss: Let believers rejoice in Allah's grace and mercy.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

refs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا . إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
refs.gloss: With hardship comes ease — stated twice for emphasis.
Whoever relieves a believer's hardship in this world, Allah will relieve his hardship on the Day of Judgment.

refs.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
refs.gloss: If you tried to count Allah's favors, you could never enumerate them.
Look at those who are less fortunate than you, not at those above you — it will help you not to belittle Allah's blessing upon you.

refs.arabic: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
refs.gloss: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
Richness is not having many possessions — true richness is the richness of the soul.

refs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
refs.gloss: Humankind and jinn were created only to worship Allah.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small.

refs.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ
refs.gloss: Life and death are created to test who does best in deeds.
The believer is like a tender plant that bends whichever way the wind blows but springs upright again; the hypocrite is like a rigid pine tree, unmoved until it is uprooted all at once.

refs.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ
refs.gloss: On that Day, even an atom's weight of good or evil will be shown.
No one's feet will move on the Day of Judgment until he is questioned about his life, his knowledge, his wealth, and his body.

refs.arabic: وَلْيَعْفُوا وَلْيَصْفَحُوا أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ
refs.gloss: Let them pardon and overlook — do you not wish that Allah should forgive you?
No one forgives except that Allah increases him in honor.

refs.arabic: إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ
refs.gloss: The believers are but brothers, so reconcile between them.
It is not lawful for a Muslim to shun his brother for more than three nights; the better of the two is the one who is first to give the greeting of peace.

refs.arabic: وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ
refs.gloss: Allah joined their hearts — had you spent all that is on earth, you could not have joined their hearts, but Allah joined them.
The believers, in mutual love and mercy, are like one body — when one part suffers, the whole responds.
